---
title: "Finding Key Files of Interest in the GREGoR Dataset"
output: html_notebook
---

The GREGoR Dataset includes a wide range of data and file formats as described in the GREGoR Data Model. Analysts working with GREGoR Data can find file paths to molecular data files using the structure of the Data Model to find specific information in workspace data tables. We have also compiled the following information about how to find certain files of broad interest.

# Setting up environment

We will use the AnVIL R package to fetch data from AnVIL data tables. First,
install the AnVILGCP package, which is needed by AnVIL.

```{r}
BiocManager::install("AnVILGCP")
library(AnVIL)
library(tidyverse)
```

Each call to AnVIL requires specifying the workspace name and namespace. For this
example, we use the AnVIL_GREGoR_R04_GRU workspace.

```{r}
workspace <- "AnVIL_GREGoR_R04_GRU"
namespace <- "anvil-datastorage"
```

# Harmonized CRAMs

Find alignment files reprocessed by the GREGoR DCC

```{r}
aligned <- avtable("aligned_dna_short_read", name=workspace, namespace=namespace)
dcc_crams <- aligned %>%
  filter(str_detect(aligned_dna_short_read_id, "^GREGoR_DCC_A1"))
head(dcc_crams)
```

Alternatively, we can query the "aligned" table which also has the participant id

```{r}
aligned <- avtable("aligned", name=workspace, namespace=namespace)
dcc_crams <- aligned %>%
  filter(str_detect(aligned_id, "GREGoR_DCC_A1"))
head(dcc_crams)
```


# gVCFs

Find single sample genomic VCFs generated by the DCC from harmonized CRAMs

```{r}
variants <- avtable("called_variants_dna_short_read", name=workspace, namespace=namespace)
gvcf <- variants %>%
  filter(str_detect(analysis_details, "gVCF generated with"))
head(gvcf)
```

Join with other tables to find the participant id. We need the AnvilDataModels package
to read the aligned_dna_short_read_set table.

```{r}
remotes::install_github("UW-GAC/AnvilDataModels")
aligned_set <- avtable("aligned_dna_short_read_set", name=workspace, namespace=namespace) %>%
  AnvilDataModels::unnest_set_table()
aligned <- avtable("aligned_dna_short_read", name=workspace, namespace=namespace) %>%
  select(aligned_dna_short_read_id, experiment_dna_short_read_id)
experiment <- avtable("experiment_dna_short_read", name=workspace, namespace=namespace) %>%
  select(experiment_dna_short_read_id, analyte_id)
analyte <- avtable("analyte", name=workspace, namespace=namespace) %>%
  select(analyte_id, participant_id)
```

```{r}
gvcf_participants <- gvcf %>%
  left_join(aligned_set) %>%
  left_join(aligned) %>%
  left_join(experiment) %>%
  left_join(analyte)
head(gvcf_participants)
```

Find phenotypes for these participants

```{r}
phenotype <- avtable("phenotype", , name=workspace, namespace=namespace) %>%
  filter(participant_id %in% gvcf_participants$participant_id)
head(phenotype)
```


# GREGoR joint callset: Unannotated & Annotated VCFs

Find unannotated and VEP annotated multi-sample chromosome VCFs generated by the DCC from single sample GVCFs. 
VCFs are split by chromosome, so each set consists of 24 files.

```{r}
variants <- avtable("called_variants_dna_short_read", name=workspace, namespace=namespace)
joint <- variants %>%
  filter(str_detect(analysis_details, "consortium-wide callset"))
head(joint)
annotated <- joint %>%
  filter(str_detect(analysis_details, "VEP annotated"))
head(annotated)
```

Match the experiment_sample_id in the VCF headers with participants. experiment_sample_id
is in the experiment_dna_short_read table. We use the aligned_dna_short_read_set_id to
identify which aligned files were used to create the VCF callset, and then join with other
tables to find experiment_sample_id and participant_id.

```{r}
remotes::install_github("UW-GAC/AnvilDataModels")
aligned_set <- avtable("aligned_dna_short_read_set", name=workspace, namespace=namespace) %>%
  AnvilDataModels::unnest_set_table()
aligned <- avtable("aligned_dna_short_read", name=workspace, namespace=namespace) %>%
  select(aligned_dna_short_read_id, experiment_dna_short_read_id)
experiment <- avtable("experiment_dna_short_read", name=workspace, namespace=namespace) %>%
  select(experiment_dna_short_read_id, experiment_sample_id, analyte_id)
analyte <- avtable("analyte", name=workspace, namespace=namespace) %>%
  select(analyte_id, participant_id)
```

```{r}
vcf_participants <- annotated %>%
  distinct(aligned_dna_short_read_set_id) %>%
  left_join(aligned_set) %>%
  left_join(aligned) %>%
  left_join(experiment) %>%
  left_join(analyte) %>%
  select(experiment_sample_id, participant_id)
head(vcf_participants)
```



# Broad de novo callset: Complete & Confident set

Find the complete and confident sets of a Consortium-wide de novo callset provided by the Broad

```{r}
variants <- avtable("called_variants_dna_short_read", name=workspace, namespace=namespace)
denovo_comp <- variants %>%
  filter(str_detect(aligned_dna_short_read_set_id, "GREGoR_DENOVO_S"))
head(denovo_comp)
denovo_conf <- variants %>%
  filter(str_detect(aligned_dna_short_read_set_id, "GREGoR_DENOVO_CONFIDENT"))
head(denovo_conf)
```


# Broad mitochondrial callset

Find the consortium-wide mitochondrial callset provided by the Broad

```{r}
variants <- avtable("called_variants_dna_short_read", name=workspace, namespace=namespace)
mtdna <- variants %>%
  filter(str_detect(aligned_dna_short_read_set_id, "Broad_U07_GS_mtDNA_callset"))
head(mtdna)
```
